title: Badge
description: Small status pills — dots, colors and a solid variant.
usage: Short status words only. Pair the dot variant with a text label; color alone is not a status.
a11y: Status is carried by the text, never by color alone; the dot is decorative. Every tone measures at least 5.26:1 (light) and 5.81:1 (dark) text contrast, and text-spacing overrides (WCAG 1.4.12) do not clip the label. Badges are not interactive. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
